content: पुलिनः, -नम् [पुल्-इनन् किच्च; <ls>Uṇ. 2. 53</ls>] .²1 A sandbank, sandy beach; रमते यमुनापुलिनवने विजयी मुरारिरधुना <ls>Gīt. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 52</ls>; sometimes used in <ab>pl.</ab>; कालिन्द्याः पुलिनेषु केलिकुपितामुत्सृज्य रासे रसम् <ls>Ve. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 A small island left in the bank of a river by the passing off of the water, an islet .²3 The bank of a river.
